<NAME>
probe_cooperators
</NAME>

<DESCRIPTION>
Cooperates initially to preserve mutual-cooperation outcomes, then performs a delayed probe. It exploits opponents that continue cooperating after the probe, while returning to cooperation when the opponent appears to forgive the probe.
</DESCRIPTION>

<CODE>
```python
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def policy(own_history, opponent_history):
    return 0 if len(opponent_history) == 0 else (1 if opponent_history.count(1) == 0 and len(opponent_history) >= 8 else (0 if opponent_history[-1] == 1 else 1 if own_history[-1] == 1 else 0))
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
```
